title: Hiring a Cook
setting: 11am. Padma the neighbour sent Saraswati your way. She's standing at your door in a maroon sari with her notebook in one hand — she's already been interviewing in this building for ten years.

beats.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸಾರ್. ಪದ್ಮ ಮ್ಯಾಡಮ್ ಹೇಳಿದರು. ನಾನು Saraswati. ಈ ಬಿಲ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು flats ಅಡಿಗೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೇನೆ.
beats.translit: namaskāra sār. Padma madam hēḷidaru. nānu Saraswati. ī building-nalli nālku flats aḍige māḍtā iddēne.
beats.en: Hello boss. Padma madam sent me. I'm Saraswati. I cook in four flats in this building.
beats.beat: doesn't step inside until you gesture

beats.prompt: You wave her in. You say:

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಆಂಟಿ, ಬನ್ನಿ. ನನಗೆ ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಅಡಿಗೆ ಬೇಕು ಒಂದು ವಾರಕ್ಕೆ. ಯಾವ days ಆಗುತ್ತೆ?
choices.translit: namaskāra aunty, banni. nanage mūru dina aḍige bēku ondu vārakke. yāva days āgutte?
choices.en: Hello aunty, come in. I need cooking three days a week. Which days work?
Yes, hi, come in. I need cooking three times a week.

beats.native: Monday, Wednesday, Friday — ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಆರ್ರಿಂದ ಎಂಟು. ಒಂದು ಬಾರಿ ಒಂದು meal. ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ಆರು ಸಾವಿರ.
beats.translit: Monday, Wednesday, Friday — beḷigge ārinda eṇṭu. ondu bāri ondu meal. tiṅgaḷige āru sāvira.
beats.en: Monday, Wednesday, Friday — six to eight in the morning. One meal per visit. Six thousand a month.
beats.beat: the rate she charges flats one floor up. no haggle in her tone.

choices.native: ಸರಿ ಆಂಟಿ. ಆರು ಸಾವಿರ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ. ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಊಟ — North Indian, South, ಎಲ್ಲ?
choices.translit: sari aunty. āru sāvira oppige. yāva rīti ūṭa — north Indian, south, ella?
choices.en: Okay aunty. Six thousand agreed. What kind of food — North Indian, South, anything?

choices.native: ಐದು ಸಾವಿರ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ ಆಂಟಿ? ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಮಾತ್ರ.
choices.translit: aidu sāvira āguttā aunty? mūru dina mātra.
choices.en: Could it be five thousand, aunty? Just three days.

beats.native: ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಸಾರ್. ಆದರೆ ಈಡಿ-ಈಡಿ list ಬೇಕು ಭಾನುವಾರ. ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದು extra ತಿಂಗಳ paid leave — festival ಗೆ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: ella māḍtīni sār. ādare īḍi-īḍi list bēku bhānuvāra. tiṅgaḷige ondu extra tiṅgaḷa paid leave — festival-ge ūrige hōgtīni.
beats.en: I'll cook anything, boss. But I need a clear weekly list by Sunday. One paid leave a month — I go home for festivals.
beats.beat: the actual terms. she's been burned before.

choices.native: ಸರಿ ಆಂಟಿ. Paid leave ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ. Sunday list ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ. Trial week start ಮಾಡೋಣ ತಾನೇ?
choices.translit: sari aunty. paid leave oppige. Sunday list koḍtīni. trial week start māḍōṇa tānē?
choices.en: Okay aunty. Paid leave agreed. I'll give you the list Sunday. Trial week, shall we?
Sounds good. Let's start next week.

beats.native: ಆಯ್ತು ಸಾರ್. ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಆರಕ್ಕೆ ಬರ್ತೀನಿ. ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ pan ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ — ನಿಮ್ಮದು ಪತ್ಲ ಇದೆ.
beats.translit: āytu sār. nāḷe beḷigge ārakke bartīni. ondu oḷḷe pan tagoḷḷi — nimmadu patla ide.
beats.en: Done, boss. Tomorrow six am. And get a good pan — yours is too thin.
beats.beat: her eyes already on your kitchen as she turns to leave
